title: Acceptance condition for the split counter
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ and $H$ be types, let $\mathrm{emb}:S\to H$ and $\mathrm{ret}:\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\to H$, and let $w$ and $s$ be finite Boolean words. For a configuration $c$ of a $k$-tape Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols and empty input, the conjunction of the condition $|w|\ge |s|+|c.\mathrm{output}|$ and the condition that the input head of the associated $(k+1)$-tape configuration reads no symbol is equivalent to $|s|+|c.\mathrm{output}|=|w|$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of a $k$-tape machine with Boolean work-tape symbols and empty input
